{{Top|leg}}
The '''Salek-Come-Home HoloNet registry''' was created by the renowned [[Kloo horn/Legends|kloo horn]] soloist [[Jimke Weet]] after the mysterious disappearance of his son [[Salak Weet|Salak]]. Weet hoped the readers of the [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] channel would contact him to provide information or donate [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] so he could continue investigations.<ref name="HNN" />

==Behind the scenes==
In "Missing Starship Search Abandoned", a [[2002]] article published in [[HoloNet News Vol. 531 49|Volume 531, Issue 49]] of the [[HoloNet News (original website)|HoloNet News website]], Salak Weet's name was consistently misspelt as "Salek".<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|regional/13328_2.html|Missing Starship Search Abandoned}}</ref>
